newsitem.title: USA: Texas Pacific to buy Belden & Blake.
newsitem.headline: Texas Pacific to buy Belden & Blake.

text.p: Belden & Blake Corp said Monday that it has signed a definitive agreement to be acquired by Texas Pacific Group, a private investment partnership, for $27 a share in cash.

Following the close of the transaction, Henry Belden IV, chairman and chief executive of Belden & Blake, and Max Mardick, president and chief operating officer, would retire from the company, although both executives would be expected to serve on the new board of directors.

Texas Pacific said it expects to name Ronald Clements, currently Belden's senior vice president of exploration and production, as the new chief executive officer and Ronald Huff, currently the company's chief financial officer, as president upon completion of the transaction.
Clements and Huff are also expected to serve on the new board of directors.
The transaction requires shareholder and regulatory approval.
